title: ServiceNow Surges 6%, Salesforce Climbs 4% as Government AI Deals Lift Enterprise Software
excerpt: Federal AI contracts are pouring into enterprise software order books, and two of the sector's most beaten-down stocks are suddenly surging. Whether today's...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • NOW jumped 6% on ServiceNow's Q2 AI contract milestone, while CRM gained 4% after Salesforce landed a $1.6 billion Veterans Affairs Agentforce deal.

  • Oracle's $7 billion Pentagon deal reinforces a government AI spending wave; this wave is helping to lift the IGV ETF, which holds both NOW and CRM as top positions.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Salesforce didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Shares of ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW) are up 6% in Friday midday trading, changing hands at $97.36. Meanwhile, Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) stock is climbing 4% to $162.56 as a wave of federal AI deal flow lifts enterprise software after months of pain.

The bounce comes off a brutal run. ServiceNow stock is down 40% year to date (YTD), and Salesforce shares have shed 40.5% over the same span. Today's session reads as an oversold rebound with two fresh, name-specific catalysts underneath it.

Both companies sit at the center of a rotation from AI infrastructure names back into application-layer software, where AI is finally translating into recurring revenue rather than raw capex.

ServiceNow's Q2 Beat and Raise Lights the Fuse

ServiceNow reported Q2 FY2026 results Wednesday after the close. The company's subscription revenue climbed 24.5% to $3.88 billion year over year (YoY), and current remaining performance obligations (cRPO) rose 21% to $13.2 billion. AI annual contract value crossed $1 billion ahead of schedule, with agentic-AI production customers up ninefold in nine months.

CEO Bill McDermott stated in the release, "ServiceNow's exceptional Q2 results solidify our position as the fastest-growing major enterprise software and cybersecurity company." ServiceNow's management raised its FY26 subscription revenue guide to at least $15.755 billion, and security products landed in 16 of the 20 largest deals thanks to Armis, Veza, and the AI Control Tower stack.

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Salesforce didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Analysts' reactions have been aggressive overall. Research reports from Bernstein (Outperform, $248), Evercore ISI ($160), JPMorgan (Overweight, $150), Cantor ($141), and Jefferies ($140) all lifted their ServiceNow stock price targets. Moreover, a fresh Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) research note flagged an "overlooked AI advantage" at a $130 Buy rating.

The bear case has weight, too. UBS cut ServiceNow stock to $110 and Neutral, noting that "demand remains mixed." Notably, ServiceNow's Q2 also benefited from federal on-premise revenue pulled forward from Q3, and the Q3 subscription guide of $3.975 to $3.98 billion sits below the $4 billion Street view. Additionally, ServiceNow's gross margin slipped to 77.9% from 81%.

ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW) 的股价在周五中午交易中上涨 6%，易手价格为 97.36 美元。 与此同时，Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) 股价上涨 4%，至 162.56 美元，因为联邦人工智能交易浪潮在经历了数月的痛苦后提振了企业软件。

反弹来自于残酷的奔跑。 ServiceNow 股价今年迄今 (YTD) 下跌了 40%，Salesforce 股价同期下跌了 40.5%。 今天的交易看起来是超卖反弹，其下方有两个新的、特定名称的催化剂。

两家公司都处于从人工智能基础设施名称转向应用层软件的中心，人工智能最终转化为经常性收入，而不是原始资本支出。

ServiceNow 的第二季度 Beat 和 Raise 点燃了导火索

ServiceNow 周三收盘后公布了 2026 财年第二季度业绩。 该公司的订阅收入同比增长 24.5% 至 38.8 亿美元，当前剩余履约义务 (cRPO) 增长 21% 至 132 亿美元。 AI 年度合同价值提前突破 10 亿美元，代理 AI 生产客户在 9 个月内增长了 9 倍。

首席执行官 Bill McDermott 在新闻稿中表示：“ServiceNow 第二季度的出色业绩巩固了我们作为增长最快的大型企业软件和网络安全公司的地位。” ServiceNow 管理层将其 2026 财年订阅收入指南提高到至少 157.55 亿美元，得益于 Armis、Veza 和 AI Control Tower 堆栈，安全产品参与了 20 笔最大交易中的 16 笔。

立即行动：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而 Salesforce 并未上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

分析师的反应总体上是积极的。 Bernstein（跑赢大盘，248 美元）、Evercore ISI（160 美元）、摩根大通（增持，150 美元）、Cantor（141 美元）和 Jefferies（140 美元）的研究报告均上调了 ServiceNow 股价目标。 此外，美国银行 (NYSE:BAC) 的一份新研究报告将“被忽视的人工智能优势”标记为 130 美元的买入评级。

熊箱也有重量。 瑞银将 ServiceNow 股票下调至 110 美元和“中性”，并指出“需求仍然好坏参半”。 值得注意的是，ServiceNow 第二季度还受益于第三季度拉动的联邦本地收入，第三季度的订阅指南为 3.975 至 39.8 亿美元，低于 40 亿美元的街景收入。 此外，ServiceNow 的毛利率从 81% 下滑至 77.9%。
